label: 05-capa-need-evidence
question: Prepare the CAPA-need evidence pack for this change, citing the supporting reports.
answer: Product code LLZ reports suddenly increased this week with 33 reports from 20260825 to 20260831. Report 50448213 states "Philips received a complaint regarding IntelliSpace Cardiovascular (ISCV), indicating that an error 500 occurs for one study, preventing the doctor from processing the report. The device was in clinical use at the time of the event, and no adverse event or patient harm was reported (PR (b)(4)).Philips has started an investigation of this complaint." Report 50426773 states "Philips received a complaint regarding IntelliSpace Cardiovascular (ISCV), indicating that unable to finalize report on Echo Module and encounter an error 500. The device was in clinical use at the time of the event, and no adverse event or patient harm was reported (PR (b)(4)).Philips has started an investigation of this complaint." The CAPA-need evidence pack for this change was recorded for a named human to review, who decides whether a CAPA is needed.
